ZS.headline: Commvault Announces Strategic Partnership with Zscaler to Help Enterprises Adopt AI with Confidence, Control, and Resilience
ZS.summary: Commvault (NASDAQ: CVLT), delivering continuous recovery for the AI era, today announced a strategic partnership with Zscaler, the cybersecurity platform for the AI era, that will help customers adopt AI with confidence and control while also being able to rollback and recover from harmful agentic activity.
